name: s(40) > 6.718 — 新支撑严格下界 / New-support strict lower bound
body:
# ZH: 新支撑严格下界 6.718
# EN: New-support strict lower bound 6.718

ZH: 精确结论为 s(40)>3359/500，允许任意旋转及所有边界接触。
EN: The exact conclusion is s(40)>3359/500, allowing arbitrary rotations and all boundary contacts.

ZH: 685 个正权 D4 矩形轨道包含 163 个原候选池外的新支撑。全部 43 个连续角带及 10,843,849 个轴向事件顶点已经完整复跑，计数矛盾余量为 1/500。
EN: The 685 positive D4 rectangle orbits include 163 new supports outside the original pool. All 43 continuous slabs and 10,843,849 axial event vertices have been replayed completely, with counting contradiction margin 1/500.

ZH: 本地和 GitHub Actions 均完成正下界及两套精确对偶检查。附件直接来自成功 CI，已重新解压和核对哈希。
EN: Local and GitHub Actions executions both complete the positive bound and two exact dual checks. The attached archive comes directly from successful CI and has been re-extracted and hash-checked.

ZH: 正下界标签为 REPLAYED_SAME_KERNEL，不表示不同代码全量几何验证、外部独立审查或形式化证明。wand125 对旧版 6.70854 的审查不覆盖本密度；旧版记录保留。
EN: The positive-bound label is REPLAYED_SAME_KERNEL, not full distinct-code geometry verification, external independent review or formal proof. wand125's review of the earlier 6.70854 result does not cover this density; prior records are preserved.

ZH: 另有两套完整精确实现核查的方法障碍：原始 2526 个均匀矩形轨道无法在 X≥6.72 形成统一收费矛盾。它不是 s(40) 的上界或 6.72 的下界。
EN: Two complete exact implementations also check a method obstruction: the original 2526 uniform rectangle orbits cannot give a uniform-charge contradiction at X≥6.72. This is neither an upper bound for s(40) nor a lower bound of 6.72.

ZH: 新支撑、改权和证书归 Guzhou0806 的 AI 辅助研究，保留 wand125 原候选池、Tokoharu 密度方法及 Joshua Levy 的 Squares Project 凹截面方法的署名。
EN: New supports, reweighting and certificates are credited to Guzhou0806's AI-assisted research, retaining credit for wand125's original pool, Tokoharu's density method and the Squares Project's concave-section method.
